- Walk through a short prompt review (15m)
- Iterate routing policy choices (model selection, fallback behavior, region preferences)
- Run a couple short load-test passes against your sample traffic (30m)

Suggested windows (all times PT):
- Tue, Dec 8 — 9:00–10:15am PT
- Wed, Dec 9 — 11:00am–12:30pm PT
- Thu, Dec 10 — 2:00–3:15pm PT

I've attached a draft agenda and a small bundle of routing examples we can use as test inputs. If none of those times work, tell me a couple of alternatives and we'll adjust. We can keep the session to 90 minutes and follow up with a shorter sync for load-test results.

Proposed attendees from Redwood: me (solutions lead), Rishi (runtime/product), Marissa (customer success). Please add any Horizon folks who should be in the room.

Quick ask: if you have a preferred region constraint (e.g., restrict to us-east-1) or an embargoed dataset for the tests, flag that so we can prepare a private instance.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
